reviews.text: Charlie always takes good care of my guinea pig. She has a really nice outdoor playground for guinea pig and indoor area. Also, my guinea pig always gains lots of weights after staying at Charlie's, which is a good news to me. That's mean he is eating  very well. Highly recommend to people looking for pet on board service. :)

Great pet boarding place if you want to board your pet bunnies and know they are safe and well taken care of. I got updates when asked of how the bunnies are doing and they are very detailed in asking how you take care of them so they do the same. Really recommend! Already have my second stay booked for the buns!

We had an amazing experience with A Furry World! We left our two guinea pigs in their care twice, and everything went smoothly each time. It gave us real peace of mind knowing our pets were well looked after. They came back happy and well cared for — we wouldn’t hesitate to use their service again!
Thank you Charlie and her team. Timmy loves being able to stay at home with your visiting service. We are able to go away without any worry knowing he will be very well cared for.  Excellent service.

Our bun Maisie absolutely loves going for her little trips to Charlie and family, she always comes home so happy and relaxed. We love receiving our picture updates of her garden adventures and snacks, Charlie and her family are so welcoming and even make space for us last minute in emergencies - wouldn’t trust anybody else with our furbaby! 🐰

Charlie is the absolute best! Always accommodating of last minute requests, and so very attentive to all my bunny Mimi’s needs! Mimi loves being at Charlie’s and always comes back from hers with a shiny coat and a happy little buncation experience! 10/10 could not recommend more!

Huge thank you to Charlie for looking after our mini lop rabbit Squash over the Christmas period. Squash has come back so happy and relaxed - we are so grateful for all Charlie's time and love nurturing her whilst we were away. Great communication throughout and really we appreciated the photos we received, as it's always so sad to leave them!
I regularly leave my bunny Lola to Charlie for the past couple of years and I can’t recommend her enough. Lola loves it there, she always comes back so relaxed.

Since I’ve seen good words I’ll put five stars but do they sell Bunnys?or is just pet sitting?because I might be getting a bunny next month for my birthday and I’m trying to get an idea of what coats I like (I think coat is right to describe bunnt fur colour I’m not sure) and I also just am obsessed with Bunnys so I love travelling to pet shops to see some Bunnys?Thanks!

Charlie is truly fantastic! Her care and dedication shine through in the way she looks after our bunnies. It’s wonderful that she sends regular updates with pictures and videos - such a thoughtful gesture that ensures peace of mind while we’re away. She clearly goes above and beyond, treating your beloved pets as if they were her own.

I’ve been sending my two rabbits to Charlie for a few years and am always so happy with the love and care they receive with every stay.

They get plenty of fresh veggies and outdoor time, and for me photo updates so I’m at ease while travelling. Even after a couple weeks away from home, both buns are very relaxed and that is down to Charlie’s outstanding knowledge of pet care and the welcoming environment she creates.

Charlie was absolutely brilliant. She looked after our Hamster Nibbles while we were on holiday and we had complete peace of mind that he was being very well cared for. She sent regular pictures to us and always responded quickly to any communication. Would 100% recommend her to look after your pets!

Charlie looks after both of my bunnies when we go away, she takes excellent care of them. I actually think they don’t want to come home! Communication is great and we receive photos and videos of the bunnies whilst away which is lovely. Gives me peace of mind to leave them in safe hands.

Charlie did a phenomenal job with our two pet rabbits! I was going on vacation for two weeks and I did extensive research to find the best pet hotel for my babies.

Charlie went above and beyond with them. She made sure there was always lots of play time and provided beautiful photos when I asked for updates. She also helped clip their names and groom them! It was also super reassuring knowing my bunnies had access to A/C during the London summer heat!

Have already rebooked for some future vacations but I can’t think of anyone better to have look after my bunnies ❤️

Charlie is amazing!!! Felt so calm and reassured the entire time our guinea pigs were with her. She really goes the extra mile to ensure they have the best stay possible. She even gave them a nail clip for us! Thank you Charlie!
Fantastic bunny sitter! I have left my bunny with Charlie several times and I trust her completely. Definitely recommend!

Charlie at A Furry World is an absolute godsend! I have now used her pet sitting services for my bunny babies three times in the last year - most recently for 11 days whilst travelling. Charlie is professional, caring and a genuine pet lover. She keeps you updated with how your pet is doing through emails and photos and puts the wellbeing of your pet at the forefront - confidently escalating any health concerns where necessary.

My bunnies love her and I would happily use her services again in the future.

My Guinea pigs love it there! Since finding Charlie I would not leave my piggies anywhere else, they are extremely well looked after and always come home happy and relaxed. Charlie would send pictures and updates to let me know how the piggies were getting on which helped me relax and enjoy my time away. Highly recommend by me and piggies :)
My piggy stayed with Charlie when I went for holidays, and defo will be booking her stay here again! She was very well looked after, couldn't be happier:-)
I have used flurry world on many occasions It's always been excellent, and I trust my beloved rabbit will be safe and well looked after. he loves it there, would always recommend
